minor.issue: Backup folders and files are created world-readable (0755/0644). They contain reseller user docs with password hashes and customer PII. Use mode 0700 for the folder and 0600 for files, or set a umask.

A manual restore of an orders backup puts the notifications that were 'cancelled' back to 'pending', so the WA worker may send old messages again. Also, restoring orders after a reset_order_seq while new orders exist can produce duplicate order codes, and restoring reseller users can fail on the unique email index if a user with the same email was recreated. The CLI then stops partway with a traceback. Consider skipping conflicts and reporting them.
Writes that are already in flight when cleanup starts are not drained (only a fixed 1s sleep). POST /api/auth/login also returns 503 during cleanup. Acceptable for a single worker; documenting only.

integration_issues.issue: The reseller view has no refetch (no polling or focus refetch), so item transitions show only after reload. The page clamp exists in code but could only be seen after reload.

issues: In the narrow 'Item Belum Selesai' column, the page-size select wraps below the 'Menampilkan ...' text, while the 'Item Selesai' pager stays on one row. The two pagers look inconsistent.
The headline 'Sistem Pemesanan Reseller RelayLab' and 'Hubungi admin RelayLab untuk reset.' stay hardcoded and do not follow the branded app name. This may be intended.
When a file over 2MB is rejected on the client, pressing Simpan still shows 'Branding aplikasi berhasil disimpan.' and saves the other fields without the logo. This could confuse users.

critical_code_review_comments: cleanup.execute: good order of steps (preview, lock, maintenance, backup with verify, delete by backed-up _ids, auto-restore on error, security log). If restore_backup itself raises during auto-restore, the exception escapes without a security_log entry; wrap it.
cleanup.preview: total counts users and resi_files as rows; fine for the UI.
storage.save_branding_image: extension and magic-byte check is good. The saved extension comes from the detected type, so cache-busting UUID filenames are fine.
settings.update_branding: the old file is removed only after the DB update. Good.
